process.name: mrem
process.description: A registrant's record under § 113. The noncitizen ground (a)(1)(E) is fed by DHS SAVE data and is exempt from the pre-election freeze (b)(1); residence removals (a)(1)(D) go through the return-card procedure (c)(2)-(3). Notice for SAVE-based removals is NOT in the text; overlay edges make that statable.

states.text: return card sent by nonforwardable mail (c)(2)
registrant notified of pending noncitizen removal (overlay — not in text)
terminal: removed from the official list

events.text: DHS SAVE information demonstrates noncitizen status
registrant returns the card confirming residence
card not returned or notice undeliverable

edges.label: TEXT_FACT
edges.text: information with respect to citizenship status supplied by the Department of Homeland Security through the Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements (``SAVE'') system that demonstrates a registrant is not a citizen of the United States

edges.label: TEXT_FACT
edges.text: the removal of names from official lists of voters at any time on a basis described in paragraph (1)(A), (1)(B), or (1)(E)

edges.label: TEXT_FACT
edges.text: change-of-address information supplied by the Postal Service through its licensees is used to identify registrants whose addresses may have changed

edges.label: TEXT_FACT
edges.text: a postage prepaid and pre-addressed return card, sent by nonforwardable mail, on which the registrant may state his or her current address

edges.label: TEXT_FACT
edges.text: the registrant should return the card not later than the time provided for mail registration

edges.label: TEXT_FACT
edges.text: the registrant shall be removed from the official list of eligible voters as described in paragraph (1)
